usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/image/ocr?url=<IMAGE_URL>&lang=eng (x402 paid, ~$0.01 USDC on Base). NOTE: method is GET with query params, NOT POST — POST returns 404.
usage.outputShape: body.text (extracted OCR text), body.confidence (0-100), body.lang, body.processing_ms, body.file_size_bytes, body.lines_count, body.words_count
quirks: Registry CALL says POST but the real endpoint is GET — POST returns 404 'Cannot POST /image/ocr'.
Registry priceDisplay is 'Free' but it actually charges $0.01 USDC (maxAmountRequired 10000 atomic) on Base.
Image is supplied via the ?url= query param (a publicly reachable image URL), NOT a request body.
Optional ?lang= query param (default eng); supports eng, chi, jpn, kor, deu, fra, spa, ita.
lines_count and words_count came back 0 even though text was extracted — rely on body.text and body.confidence, not the count fields.
Despite the registry name 'Image & PDF to Text', the 402 description only mentions Tesseract OCR on image URLs; PDF support is unverified.
usage.guide: Call this endpoint as a GET request (NOT POST, despite the registry listing POST). Put the public image URL in the ?url= query param, e.g. GET https://api.x402node.dev/image/ocr?url=https://example.com/scan.png and optionally &lang=eng. It is x402-paid (~$0.01 USDC on Base), no API key/SIWX needed — just pay via your wallet. Read the extracted text from body.text and the OCR quality from body.confidence (0-100). Ignore lines_count/words_count which can be 0 even on success.
